protocol.purpose: Test whether a causal market-suitability gate can block market episodes that have historically been unsuitable for the predeclared candidate signals. This is not a strategy selector.
protocol.episode_definition: One ticker/H1 signal close with one or more of six predeclared candidate rules. Episode outcome is the equal-weight mean gross return of its active candidate trades; this is a diagnostic market-condition label, not a portfolio return.
protocol.causality: An episode is added to training only after all candidate trades in that episode have exited strictly before the current signal bar. No current or future episode outcome is visible to the gate.
protocol.gate: Rolling latest 100 completed episodes per ticker/regime key; minimum 30. Backoff: joint trend+volatility, trend-only, volatility-only, then all regimes. Allow only if mean net episode return after 10 bps per side is positive and PF > 1.0; otherwise no trade.
protocol.regime: Ticker-specific causal trend-strength and ATR/close volatility ranks. Each metric is ranked against up to 120 prior observations, excluding current; at least 60 prior observations; low/mid/high terciles.
protocol.execution: Signal on completed H1 close; next H1 open entry; close after at most 12 H1 bars. Candidate streams are non-overlapping within each ticker/rule. Filter decision is common to all candidate rules firing at the same ticker/H1 close.
protocol.walk_forward: First half of first 80% is warm-up; remaining first 80% split into three chronological development folds; final 20% separately. Gate state carries forward using only prior completed episodes.
protocol.costs: Gate training threshold: 10 bps per side. Reported trade metrics: 5 and 10 bps per side, illustrative only.
protocol.overlap_note: Different strategy streams may overlap. Per-rule results are reported as independent diagnostic streams; pooled multi-rule trade chains are deliberately not presented as portfolio performance.

limitations: Diagnostic only: the same historical archive and final 20% have been examined in previous experiments; this is not independent confirmation.
The episode suitability label averages the outcomes of whichever candidate strategies fired; it is a research proxy, not a tradable benchmark or portfolio return.
The six candidate strategies are correlated and can overlap across rules; per-rule streams are not a combined portfolio.
Ticker-specific regimes are not a common MOEX-wide market regime.
Actual spread, commissions, slippage, borrow availability/cost, taxes and market impact are not modeled; 5/10 bps per side are illustrative.
Finam H1 bars are technical data; 12 bars are not necessarily 12 clock hours.
Research only: no production, real signals, Telegram notifications, cron changes, secrets or broker orders.
